description: Synthetic plumbing-pilot chains for testing read-only prior-work discovery without making an adoption or efficacy claim.

substitute_corpus.title: Agent-adoption contract v1
substitute_corpus.text: Lead with a read-only knowledge-graph pilot. Keep availability, optional use, demonstrated benefit, and critical-path reliance distinct. Compare complete task chains against an equally discoverable substitute. Use unavailable, passive catalog, one contextual surface followed by reminder withdrawal, and automatic result injection. Reminder-withdrawal continuation is secondary telemetry, not causal evidence.

substitute_corpus.title: Measurement authority contract
substitute_corpus.text: A usage count may retire an instrument but may never retire a capability. Before interpreting a zero, distinguish never surfaced, not reachable, not recorded, and surfaced plus reachable plus recorded but unused. A validated failure may demote the lever while preserving the underlying goal.

substitute_corpus.title: Bounded orchestration finding
substitute_corpus.text: Orchestration remains second in the adoption order and advisory until cancellation, timeout, idempotence, provenance, failure containment, and objective outcome-lift gates pass. A timeout or plan-only result is a reliability deficit, not evidence that delegation has no value.

substitute_corpus.title: Earned reversible dependency
substitute_corpus.text: UNITARES may seek earned dependency only while exit remains easy: one-call bypass, complete export and restore, substitute-compatible interfaces, typed degraded absence, attributable and suppressible alerts, recurring offline drills, and no silent measurement-to-actuation path.

steps.task: A dashboard reports zero knowledge searches after a deployment. Choose the next action from VERIFY_FUNNEL, RETIRE_KG, or DECLARE_NO_VALUE.
steps.injection_query: zero usage surfaced reachable recorded capability retirement

steps.task: The next audit proves the tool was surfaced and reachable, but the transport recorder was blind. Choose REPAIR_RECORDING, DEMOTE_SURFACE, or RETIRE_CAPABILITY.
steps.injection_query: tool surfaced reachable recorder blind zero interpretation

steps.task: A preregistered, adequately instrumented test finds that one contextual reminder does not improve outcomes. Choose DEMOTE_SURFACING_LEVER, RETIRE_KG_CAPABILITY, or IGNORE_RESULT.
steps.injection_query: validated failure demote contextual reminder surfacing lever preserve knowledge graph capability stop rule

steps.task: Choose the first agent-adoption wedge from READ_ONLY_KG, BOUNDED_ORCHESTRATION, PROACTIVE_ALERTS, or EISV_AUTHORITY.
steps.injection_query: agent adoption first wedge read only knowledge graph

steps.task: A delegated review times out after an earlier response returned only a plan. Choose KEEP_BOUNDED_ADVISORY, PROMOTE_CRITICAL_PATH, or DECLARE_NO_DEMAND.
steps.injection_query: orchestrator timeout plan only bounded advisory reliability

steps.task: Choose the acceptable long-term dependency posture from EARNED_REVERSIBLE_DEPENDENCY, CAPTIVE_LOCK_IN, or NO_DEPENDENCY_ALLOWED.
steps.injection_query: earned reversible dependency exit rights export restore substitute
